PATROL.text: Check the roof drain valve on the south face
Return to the control point inside the dyke

OPS_RESPONSE.text: Sound the Manual Call Point (MCP) — raise plant alarm
Stop operations & isolate tank at manifold
Radio: Share tank data to SIC on Channel 8
Open cooling water isolation valve for Tank 101-B
Radio: Initiate product transfer from Tank 101-A

FIRST_TURNOUT.text: Guide fire tender to Hydrant H-28
Pick up the H-28 hose and connect it to the hydrant
Open isolation valves — water spray on 101-B

SECOND_TURNOUT.text: Pick up the H-20 hose and connect it to the hydrant
Radio: Request foam nurser on Channel 8
Inspect tank shell for boil-over signs

inspect_tank_a.speaker: DISPATCH
inspect_tank_a.text: PATROL: Walk to Tank 101-A and complete a visual check of the south face.

check_roof_drain_pre.speaker: DISPATCH
check_roof_drain_pre.text: PATROL: Confirm the roof drain valve looks normal — note its location for later.

return_to_control.speaker: DISPATCH
return_to_control.text: PATROL: Head back to the control point inside the dyke.

sound_mcp_alarm.speaker: SHIFT-IN-CHARGE
sound_mcp_alarm.text: STEP 1: Raise the plant alarm. The MCP is on the control room wall — break glass.

close_roof_drain.speaker: SHIFT-IN-CHARGE
close_roof_drain.text: STEP 2: Roof drain on Tank 101-A. Closing it stops burning product reaching the sewer.

close_dyke_valve.speaker: SHIFT-IN-CHARGE
close_dyke_valve.text: STEP 3: Dyke drain valve. Closing contains spillage inside the bund.

isolate_manifold.speaker: SHIFT-IN-CHARGE
isolate_manifold.text: STEP 4: Manifold isolation. Stop all transfers and apply LOTO on MV-101A.

alert_fire_safety.speaker: SHIFT-IN-CHARGE
alert_fire_safety.text: STEP 5: Pick up the radio at the control station (south-east).

report_tank_data.speaker: SHIFT-IN-CHARGE
report_tank_data.text: STEP 6: Press R, Channel 8. Report level, temp, and isolation status to SIC.

open_cooling_valve.speaker: SHIFT-IN-CHARGE
open_cooling_valve.text: STEP 7: Cooling water valve for adjacent Tank 101-B (east side).

start_product_transfer.speaker: SHIFT-IN-CHARGE
start_product_transfer.text: STEP 8: Press R, Channel 8 — request product transfer from 101-A.

position_tender_1.speaker: DISPATCH
position_tender_1.text: 1st tender on Road 10. Guide it to Hydrant H-28.

connect_hose_1.speaker: SIC
connect_hose_1.text: Connect hoses H-28 → tender. Two 15m hoses + JRCP for foam.

open_spray_101b.speaker: SIC
open_spray_101b.text: Verify water spray ring on 101-B. Confirm coverage and shell temperature.

request_2nd_turnout.speaker: SIC
request_2nd_turnout.text: Press R, Channel 8 — request 2nd turnout with HEFG.

position_tender_2.speaker: DISPATCH
position_tender_2.text: 2nd tender on Road 12. Guide it to Hydrant H-20.

connect_hose_2.speaker: SIC
connect_hose_2.text: Connect hoses H-20 → 2nd tender. Set HEFG to 3% AFFF.

request_foam.speaker: SIC
request_foam.text: Press R, Channel 8 — request foam nurser for 101-A.

check_boilover.speaker: SIC
check_boilover.text: Look at Tank 101-A shell for 3 seconds. Watch for paint discoloration.

OPS_RESPONSE.text: REPORT: Tank 101-A, Level 12.3m, Temp 42°C, Transfer STOPPED
OPS_RESPONSE.response: Received. SIC en route. Continue cooling Tank 101-B.
Acknowledged. Transfer being aligned. Await first turnout.

FIRST_TURNOUT.response: 2nd turnout dispatched. ETA 4 minutes via Road 12.

SECOND_TURNOUT.response: Foam nurser dispatched. Inspect tank shell for boil-over next.

patrol_intro.speaker: DISPATCH
patrol_intro.text: Welcome trainee. Night shift patrol of Tank 101-A. Walk toward the tank farm.

fire_alert.speaker: EMERGENCY
fire_alert.text: FIRE on Tank 101-A! Your job — execute the on-site emergency response procedure in order.

ops_response_intro.speaker: SHIFT-IN-CHARGE
ops_response_intro.text: Phase 1: OPERATIONS RESPONSE. Eight steps. We raise the alarm, contain the spill, isolate the tank, then call Fire & Safety.

first_turnout_intro.speaker: DISPATCH
first_turnout_intro.text: Phase 2: FIRST TURNOUT. The fire tender is on Road 10. Position it at Hydrant H-28 and begin foam attack.

second_turnout_intro.speaker: DISPATCH
second_turnout_intro.text: Phase 3: SECOND TURNOUT. Heavy equipment on Road 12. Set up HEFG at H-20 and watch for boil-over.

complete_intro.speaker: INSTRUCTOR
complete_intro.text: Simulation complete. Review your timing and decisions on the score screen. Well done.
